findings.description: Byte-identical client and upstream hex to 6baf167b with only the port differing: the `100` aborts, the client sees `502` then `200` with `SEQ:2 EXEC:uid=1000`, body re-parsed and executed 2/2. The forwarding loop at `:84` iterates `req.h` in client order with only the hop-by-hop set removed, so the `Expect` header reaches the upstream verbatim and is what provokes the interim response.
findings.title: Same interim-`100` abort into 502 with the body re-parsed and executed upstream, on a client-order header loop

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
